cards.card_text: Job says God has made him a byword among the people, a man in whose ___ they spit.
cards.verse_text: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.
cards.snippet: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.

cards.card_text: He has become a byword among them.
cards.verse_text: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
cards.snippet: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.

cards.card_text: They're a byword among the nations and a laughingstock, and shame covers his face at the voice of the scorner and the reviler, the enemy bent on revenge.
cards.verse_text: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
cards.snippet: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.

cards.card_text: She becomes a byword among women, and judgment is carried out against her.
cards.verse_text: Thus she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.
cards.snippet: Thus she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.
